messages:
lena_sales: AuroraHealth needs a 2-week POC limited to Canada + EU. Requirements: BYOK (customer-managed KMS), zero US subprocessors touching PHI, and routing that absolutely never falls back to US. Also wants per-region egress and latency in reports.

omar_se: Quick clarifiers: do they need control-plane isolation or only data-plane? If they accept hosted control plane, we can do Dedicated with hard tenant pin. If not, Private required.

rui_ops: Ops notes: we can pin tenant to CA/EU pools and disable cross-region fallback. Telemetry can be disabled. To enforce no-US subproc, we must remove US subproc access for that tenant—legal sign-off required. BYOK: we accept AWS/GCP KMS ARNs; require HSM-backed key and allow-use policy.

ida_security: Security checklist (HIPAA): signed BAA before any data; subproc attestation (no US access); KMS attestation (HSM + rotation); retain audit logs 365d and provide export; any deferred controls need written customer approval. If control-plane can't be in US, recommend Private.

legal-bot: legal-bot: Uploaded NDA and initial security questionnaire to vault: https://vault.redwood.example/aurora-2026 :lock:

lena_sales: Pricing/timing questions from AE: what's monthly uplift for a 2-GPU equivalent Dedicated pool with pin + BYOK? one-time enablement days? can we show per-region egress billing?

rui_ops: Ballpark: Dedicated small reserved pool ~$5,900/mo + ~10% ops surcharge for BYOK/pin. One-time setup 2-4 business days if legal quick. We tag egress and can export per-region CSV; Console shows latency percentiles by region.

omar_se: Action items: @rui_ops share 1-page POC checklist (KMS ARNs, subproc attestation, contact) by EOD. @ida_security list which HIPAA items can be timeboxed for 2-week POC. @lena_sales confirm with AE whether hosted control-plane is acceptable.

lena_sales: I'll check with AE now and update. Keeping this thread as single source of truth. :thumbsup:
